note: 原桥接句写'multiple organizations each claiming to have started the same day'与目标文章不符（目标文章national-cat-day实际是四个不同名称、不同创始人、不同日期的'猫节'，彼此容易混淆，不是'多个组织争抢同一天的创办权'）；已改写为'found four differently named, differently founded observances that get confused with one another'，与目标文章核心内容（'Cat day' is not one observance; it is a name loosely shared by at least four of them...founded by Colleen Paige/IFAW/Wayne H. Morris/Cats Protection'）精确吻合，同站另一处桥接句（Virgo's dates页）用几乎相同措辞'four differently named, differently founded observances'描述同一目标文章，可交叉印证用词准确。
